ns2:course.label: Biophysics Seminars
ns2:course.description: Survey of literature in one area of biophysics, with special emphasis on student reports. 1 to 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in Biophysics and Quantitative Biology.
